description: This file defines the class DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, which wraps and delegates logging operations to an underlying DiagnosticLoggingAdapter. It provides thread-unsafe (not-thread-safe) logging with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management, including discarding and modifying MDC entries.

classes.name: DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A wrapper for DiagnosticLoggingAdapter that manages MDC and delegates logging calls, with thread-unsafe behavior.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create instances of DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.
